title: Generated ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT malformed-body recovery profile
scope: CLI disposition for a bounded malformed standard fixed-type ProxyObject across six generated DWG revisions, with following-frame continuation, strict refusal, and explicit-partial output readback where admitted.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser recovery inventory
selection.reason: The fixed type 499 ProxyObject parser has bounded optional metadata fields and can be exercised without asserting opaque proxy payload or originating custom-class semantics.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the local dwg_local_roundtrip test writer in the temporary test directory; generated DWG and DXF files are removed by the test runner.
source.profile: One standard fixed-type 499 ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT at handle 0x700, with absent class ID, an empty subclass string where present, absent drawing-format metadata (or absent DWG and maintenance versions in AC1032), from-DXF false, an empty opaque payload, and a following LINE at handle 0x701.
source.mutation: The generator writes and reads the valid generated source, then searches only the bounded body of its authored raw object for a one-bit mutation rejected by DRW_ProxyObject::parseDwg. The selected mutation preserves the common object prologue and object handle.

AC1027.output: refused by the existing source-reference gate

assertions: Each malformed source reports one failed OBJECTS frame, continues to the following LINE, and balances source, published, and failed frame accounting.
Strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically and preserves the destination sentinel at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion and fresh DXF readback retain the LINE at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032.
AC1027 strict and explicit-partial output remain refused by the existing source-reference gate.
